definition.proposition: In the GDN x shared-loops x ternary factorial (14 block applications, FLOPs-matched; 20M tokens on code-py-v2), the ingredients' effects are not additive: the registered interaction I = y111 - y100 - y010 - y001 + 2*y000 is -3.5% (SYNERGY), i.e. the full fusion's loss penalty is ~3.5% smaller than the sum of the single-ingredient effects. The full fusion is still ~11% worse than the dense control; GDN alone is the best cell (-7.3% vs dense).
definition.refutation_criteria: At 200M (SQ263) or on replication, the seed-blocked I's 95% CI includes 0 or lies above 0
